Primary.purpose: Core model, proposed method, or main solution
Primary.avoid: Do not assign to every series

Secondary.purpose: Supporting method, secondary response, or uncertainty edge
Secondary.avoid: Do not let it outrank Primary

Highlight.purpose: Optimum, critical point, selected threshold, or one key finding
Highlight.avoid: Do not use for routine series or large areas

Neutral.avoid: Do not use for the main conclusion

Warning.purpose: Constraint violation, failure, or adverse exception
Warning.avoid: Do not use merely for palette variety

accessibility.grayscale_redundancy: Use line style and marker shape in addition to hue
